scope: Exploratory out-of-fold G-gated Prompt model selection on the frozen full2638 corrected-L2 arms; CPU-only, read-only; NOT a new formal claim and NOT a gate.
external_validation_caveat: Threshold discovery here uses the same full2638 corpus under 5-fold cross-validation, so the OOF score is an internally cross-validated estimate, not an untouched external evaluation. A paper/formal claim still requires replaying the frozen policy on an external frozen dataset.
external_validation_caveat_zh: 阈值发现与评估共用同一 full2638 语料（5-fold 交叉验证），因此 OOF 分数只是内部交叉验证估计，不是未触碰的外部评测；在提出论文/正式主张之前，必须把冻结策略在外部冻结数据集上重放。

design.fold_assignment: strata processed in sorted order; ids sorted (numeric-aware) and shuffled with one random.Random(fold_seed); dealt round-robin across the folds
design.policy_rule: never_prompt uses the integer-L2 arm on every sample; always_prompt uses the Prompt+integer-L2 arm on every sample; prompt_if_G_gt_T uses the Prompt arm iff the pre-selector G = full_llm_visual_tokens is strictly greater than T, else the integer-L2 arm. No task/source/dataset identity enters any policy.
design.selection_rule: In each fold keep the other four folds, score all six candidate policies with the official cv_bench_accuracy, pick the maximum; exact ties prefer the lower Prompt-use rate, then the fixed order (never_prompt, always_prompt, prompt_if_G_gt_96, prompt_if_G_gt_256, prompt_if_G_gt_512, prompt_if_G_gt_1024). Apply the winner unchanged to the held-out fold.

checks: exactly N identical unique sample_ids in the manifest and both arm files
no duplicate sample_id in any input
every arm record carries arm / budget=96 / region_grid=3 / local_cap=16 / integer score mode
every arm record manifest_sha256 equals the pinned manifest digest
task matches the manifest; source/source_dataset come from the manifest
non-bypass emits K=96; bypass emits G == full_llm_visual_tokens
selected_group_indices strictly ascending, unique, length==output_group_count, sha256 re-verified
prompt arm carries the config-pinned checkpoint hashes; integer arm carries none
G / grid / bypass / counts identical across the two arms

oof_minus_dense_descriptive.role: descriptive context only; no bootstrap is run for dense

limitations: Threshold discovery here uses the same full2638 corpus under 5-fold cross-validation, so the OOF score is an internally cross-validated estimate, not an untouched external evaluation. A paper/formal claim still requires replaying the frozen policy on an external frozen dataset.
This is exploratory model selection over frozen outputs; it changes no raw output, config or prior report and creates no formal claim.
The official cv_bench_accuracy requires all three sources (ADE20K, COCO, Omni3D); inside single-source task/source strata only the unweighted sample accuracy is reported and it is not a gate.
Threshold discovery and evaluation share the same full2638 corpus under cross-validation; selections being stable across folds does not make the score an external evaluation.
No GPU, model, board, network or training is used; the whole diagnostic is a CPU-only read-only re-analysis of frozen JSONLs.
